claim: Implemented a standalone one-block-per-row RMSNorm kernel using coalesced strided loads, per-thread fused multiply-add accumulation, warp-shuffle sum-of-squares reduction, and a small shared-memory warp-total array on sm_70.
expected_effect: The 256-thread block maps naturally to eight Volta warps, keeping row accesses coalesced while replacing most reduction synchronization and shared-memory traffic with warp shuffles. The 32-float shared array is conflict-free for warp leaders, and the single reciprocal RMS value is reused across the output pass, reducing redundant work and global memory overhead on Tesla V100.
